title: Reducing vector coordinates with PCA
description: You can compare the input array's shape with its transformed coordinates.

steps.description: vectors contains four rows with three coordinates each. You import principal component analysis, PCA, to transform those rows.
n_components=2 requests two transformed coordinates per vector. You store that configuration in pca.

steps.question: Will fit_transform reduce the number of vector rows?
steps.answer: No. It keeps four rows and transforms each from three coordinates to two.

steps.description: You see the original and reduced arrays printed. In this recording the second transformed coordinate is near zero for all four rows.
